summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called UBT251 injection in adults who have obesity and moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea, which is a sleep disorder where breathing repeatedly stops and starts. Researchers want to compare the study drug against an inactive placebo substance given as weekly shots. The trial plans to enroll 150 participants who will continue using their positive airway pressure therapy during the 52-week study. NCT07806851 is the trial's identification number.
